title: Health App Stories Presentation
whatItIs: A grey board titled Stories Presentation with a rounded white panel holding three story frames: bold headline with a hand-held phone, a phone showing analytics, and a headline with an AI orb phone.
whatItMeans: Stories with big hands and screens make the product feel tangible, and consistent chrome links the trio.
techniques: Three frames with identical header and reply bar
Hands holding phones at different angles
Bold headline on first, quiet ones on others
Blue-to-violet orb as the AI symbol
Dashed grid lines behind the frames

vocabulary.definition: A vertical panel with story-style header and reply bar.
A glossy gradient sphere used as an AI symbol.
A rounded container holding a set of designs.
